_comment: Declares that this record's stored text CANNOT be re-derived from its stored original. Checked and falsification-tested by scripts/derive_text.py.
not_derivable_reason: The strongest case in the corpus. capture_history shows the text was captured from the AUSTRALIAN TREATY SERIES via AustLII (08a6441aaae8...) 'because UNOOSA/UN sources for this treaty were repeatedly unavailable', and only later 'Re-sourced from UNOOSA ST/SPACE/61/Rev.3 compilation, replacing the Australian Treaty Series interim source' (63147c6dc696...). The stored text is a DIFFERENT PUBLISHER'S rendering of the same treaty. This accounts for the interleaved footnote blocks ('2United Nations, Treaty Series, vol. 672, No. 9574.') sitting mid-document, which belong to the AustLII typesetting and not to the UNOOSA volume now stored as the original.
_remedy: Re-deriving would require storing the ORIGINAL capture artefact alongside the upgraded anchor. That is an ingest decision, not a recipe problem.
